label: preparing
what: A coordinated, private bridge-or-port-change plan is under preparation at the bakery; the exact change is unclear. Evidence identifies baker and innkeeper, builder, freight, and neighbour as associated/participants in the reported gatherings. The builder/freight conversation explicitly mentions a committee's supplies, and the innkeeper has a private bread order debt of 44 emeralds payable after the jubilee. The mayor was not initially informed; the evening hall lighting inspection appears to serve as cover or coincide with a planned private arrangement at 18:00.
